description: This file defines a ValidatorActionFilter class implementing ASP.NET Core's IActionFilter interface, used to validate model state before executing an action and return JSON errors if validation fails.

classes.name: ValidatorActionFilter
classes.description: A filter to validate model state in ASP.NET Core MVC actions, returning JSON error response if invalid.

methods.name: OnActionExecuting
methods.description: Checks if the model state is valid; if not, serializes validation errors into JSON and sets the HTTP response with status code 422.

methods.name: OnActionExecuted
methods.description: Empty method implementation, can be used for post-action logic if needed.
